incident: Checkout feature flag points to missing payment route
symptoms: only users in the new checkout cohort were affected
application logs showed missing route errors
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A feature flag enabled a new payment route before the route was deployed to production.
resolution: A feature flag activated functionality before its backend route existed. Disabling the flag restored checkout without a full rollback.
postmortem: Pod restarts did not create the missing route.
CDN clearing was unrelated to the backend 404.
